step.name: createClientCert
step.title: (Optional) Create and export a client certificate
step.description: Creates a client certificate, creates client CA and adds it to server trust store and exports the certificates to keystore files

step.name: createClientCa
step.title: Create client CA
step.description: Create a certificate authority to sign the client certificate with

targetStateSet.description: Only create the certificate authority if requested

step.instructions: Submit rexx exec to execute step

step.name: createClientCertificate
step.title: Create client certificate
step.description: Create a certificate for the user
step.instructions: Submit rexx exec to execute step

step.name: addClientCaToServerTrust
step.title: Add client CA to server trust ring
step.description: Add the client CA to the server trust ring, so that the server accepts certificates signed by that CA, remember to restart the server
step.instructions: Submit rexx exec to execute step, remember to restart the server afterwards

step.name: exportClientCertificates
step.title: Export client certificate and server CA
step.description: Export the client certificate and the server CA
step.instructions: Submit rexx exec to execute step

step.name: exportCertificateToUSS
step.title: Export certificates to USS
step.description: Export the client certificate and server CA to USS and create PKCS12 keystores
step.instructions: Submit shell script to execute step
